We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The facts: In 2011, defendant Zhu applied for registration of a company (Taizhou Jinxiangyi Ecological Agriculture Development Co., Ltd). He lacked 5 million registration capital, so he hired Wang to provide the capital and paid 30,000 fee. Zhu used fraud to deceive the registration authority, obtained business license, then withdrew the 5 million to repay Wang. After, he turned himself in.

This is a case of fraudulent registration of a company, i.e., false registration, using false capital. In Chinese criminal law, this is "虚假注册公司" or "骗取注册资本" maybe "公司登记虚假记载" which falls under "诈骗罪" (fraud) or "非法经营罪"? Actually there is a specific crime: "虚假注册公司" is covered under "诈骗罪" (fraud) or "非法经营罪"? Let's recall: Under Chinese Criminal Law, article 224 (2) deals with "非法经营罪" includes "以非法占有为目的，骗取国家税务机关或者其他部门的资金" etc. But there is also "公司登记虚假记载罪" under article 210? Actually article 210 is "伪造、变造国家机关公文、证件、印章罪". Not that. There is "虚假注册公司" under "诈骗罪"? I think the typical charge is "诈骗罪" (fraud) because he deceived the registration authority to obtain a business license and capital. In many case law, "骗取注册资本" is considered "诈骗罪". Also there is "非法经营罪" for operating a business without registration or with false registration. But here the act is to obtain registration by fraud, then withdraw capital. So likely "诈骗罪" (fraud). Also maybe "公司登记虚假记载罪" (false record in company registration) which is a specific crime under article 210? Actually article 210 is about forging official documents. But there is a separate crime: "公司登记虚假记载罪" under article 210? Let's check: In Chinese law, there is "公司、企业、事业单位登记虚假记载罪" (Article 210 of Criminal Law). Yes, article 210 (2) says: "公司、企业、事业单位登记虚假记载罪" is for those who, for the purpose of illegal gain, make false records in registration of companies, enterprises, institutions. The penalty is up to 3 years or more. So the appropriate charge is "公司登记虚假记载罪". In the examples, they often use generic terms like "诈骗" or "非法吸收公众存款". Thus answer: [罪名]公司登记虚假记载罪<eoa>
